answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 21434 Country: India Title: Q; According to Islam,female feticide is justified. If a person has several daughters and his wife has a new pregnancy then tests of gender is justified. Question: as salamvalekum I want to ask a question. Pls answer as soon as possible. Q; According to Islam,female feticide is justified. If a person has several daughters and his wife has a new pregnancy then tests of gender is justified. Pls send answer as soon as possible. Answer ID: 21434 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 542/542/M=1431) It is unlawful and haram. It is the practice of jahiliya (pre-Islamic era). Islam does not allow it. وَلاَ تَقْتُلُواْ أَوْلادَكُمْ خَشْيَةَ إِمْلاقٍ . [الإسراء : 31] Yes, if four months have not passed on pregnancy, then in some particular and inevitable circumstances it is allowed to abort. Conducting gender test is not right. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
